name: @switchback/ingest-worker
description: Azure Functions host for the ingest queue: a Service Bus trigger that drains one job per message.
//concurrency: The Overpass ceiling is two concurrent requests and it is enforced here by `maxConcurrentCalls: 1` in host.json times the one `OverpassClient` singleton in packages/ingest/src/config.ts, which caps itself at 2. Both halves matter and README.md traces the whole chain, including the two app settings this workspace does not own.
